scripts.dev: (npx kill-port 3000 3001 || true) && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.litellm: (npx kill-port 4000 || true) && ([ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a) || true && export LITELLM_MASTER_KEY="${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY:-sk-litellm}" && (PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.11/bin:/usr/local/opt/python@3.11/bin:$PATH" litellm --config ./litellm/config.yaml --port 4000 || (echo 'LiteLLM not found for Python 3.11. Run: npm run litellm:install' && exit 1))
